Pure. Wholesome. Naturally Grown.

Discover the ancient superfood of India — Makhana (Fox Nuts / Lotus Seeds) — harvested from pristine freshwater ponds and sun-dried to perfection. Light, crunchy, and packed with nutrition, Makhana is the guilt-free snack your pantry has been waiting for.

Why You'll Love It

  • 🌿 100% Natural — no additives, no preservatives, no artificial flavours
  • 💪 High in Protein & Fibre — keeps you full and energised
  • 🫀 Low Glycaemic Index — suitable for diabetics and weight-watchers
  • 🧘 Rich in Antioxidants — supports healthy ageing and immunity
  • ☁️ Feather-Light & Crunchy — perfect for roasting, curries, or eating straight from the pack

How to Enjoy

Roast with a drizzle of ghee and rock salt for a classic snack, toss into kheer for a festive dessert, or blend into a nutritious smoothie. The possibilities are as wholesome as the seed itself.

Product Details

  • Origin: Mithila Region, Bihar, India
  • Type: Whole Lotus Seeds (Fox Nuts)
  • Packaging: Resealable, food-safe pouch
  • Best Before: 6 months from date of packaging

From the heart of India's wetlands to your home — pure, natural, and nourishing.
